abstract: The computed tomography manifestations of 39 patients with histologically proved anterior mediastinal tumors were studied by categorizing the tumors by content as solid homogeneous, cystic homogeneous, and heterogeneous. Among 24 solid tumors, thymomas were easily distinguished by their lack of invasiveness from malignant lymphomas and germ-cell tumors. Among 11 cystic tumors, pericardial and thymic cysts were differentiated from cystic teratomas and bronchogenic cysts by their lack of recognizable capsules with or without calcification. The differential diagnosis of a variety of tumors of the anterior mediastinum was facilitated by computed tomography in all but a few exceptional cases.
abstract_ja: 組織学的に確認された前縦隔腫瘍39例について、コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)所見を内容により充実性均一型、嚢胞性均一型、不均一型に分類して検討した。充実性腫瘍24例のうち、胸腺腫は浸潤性がないことにより悪性リンパ腫や胚細胞腫瘍と容易に区別された。嚢胞性腫瘍11例のうち、心膜嚢胞や胸腺嚢胞は、認識可能な被膜の有無や石灰化の有無により、嚢胞性奇形腫や気管支原性嚢胞と区別された。前縦隔の多様な腫瘍の鑑別診断は、一部の例外を除きすべてCTにより容易になった。
